what: After the accepted change, while test #2 ran its command under the new pipeline version, a work_finished event (passed: true) carrying the OLD spec hash was applied with LocalRun.apply, the path the engine's own command results take. In format 1 only engine results (work_finished, check_finished) carry a spec hash; an agent's hand-in does not.
verdict: dropped: the old engine treats a result of another pipeline version as a repeat (ok, noop) and changes nothing; the real result of the new version decided the attempt
